productArea.name: Models
productArea.scope: Search, filter, create, edit, publish, and delete models, including their content, record attributes, metadata, publication schedule, and missing-record navigation. Model type definitions, attribute definitions, structures, and translations are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Modeling then Models or a pinned model type, and open a model to edit its content, attributes, and publication.
Choose Create model from the list and select its model type.
